description: shitty-pdf-bench: forty public adversarial PDFs for non-OCR document-to-Markdown quality, robustness, and throughput evaluation. Files are downloaded from their publishers and are not redistributed.

documents.title: Attention Is All You Need
documents.rationale: Compact two-column research paper with equations, tables, references, and vector figures.

documents.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
documents.rationale: Long two-column paper with dense benchmark tables, equations, footnotes, and appendices.

documents.title: Sparks of Artificial General Intelligence
documents.rationale: Figure-heavy 155-page research report mixing prose, code, equations, plots, and multi-column appendices.

documents.title: ECMAScript 2024 Language Specification
documents.rationale: 816-page formal standard with deeply nested algorithms, grammar productions, tables, notes, and links.

documents.title: ESP32 Technical Reference Manual
documents.rationale: 784-page SoC manual with register maps, bit fields, timing diagrams, and dense tables.

documents.title: FAA Interagency Air Committee Charting Specifications
documents.rationale: Charting specification containing congested and rotated airport diagrams, symbols, tiny labels, and technical tables.

documents.title: AURIX TC3xx User’s Manual Part 2
documents.rationale: 3,561-page manual that previously exposed MacExpertEncoding and font-recovery failures.

documents.title: AURIX TC3xx User’s Manual Part 1
documents.rationale: 2,080-page manual with dense register descriptions, framed fields, diagrams, and repeated chrome.

documents.title: Intel 700 Series Chipset Family Specification Update
documents.rationale: Short errata document with structured issue tables and strong repeated page chrome.

documents.title: Intel 700 Series Chipset Family PCH Datasheet Volume 1
documents.rationale: PCH datasheet with compact electrical tables, register fields, callouts, and side-by-side content.

documents.title: IRS Form 1040 (2024)
documents.rationale: Two-page fillable tax form dominated by positioned labels, ruled cells, checkboxes, and form widgets.

documents.title: IRS Form 1040 Instructions (2024)
documents.rationale: 113-page multi-column government instructions with worksheets, tables, callouts, and repeated headers.

documents.title: Israel State Comptroller Public Service Report
documents.rationale: 268-page right-to-left Hebrew report with charts, long tables, page furniture, and mixed numerals.

documents.title: Japan Statistical Yearbook 2024
documents.rationale: 795-page bilingual Japanese/English statistical yearbook dominated by wide, dense numeric tables.

documents.title: SAM E70/S70/V70/V71 Family Data Sheet
documents.rationale: 2,007-page MCU datasheet with pinouts, register maps, framed value columns, and timing tables.

documents.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook Rev. 2
documents.rationale: 297-page handbook with process diagrams, callout boxes, tables, equations, and mixed layouts.

documents.title: i.MX 8M Mini Applications Processor Reference Manual
documents.rationale: 5,319-page processor reference manual stressing page trees, repeated chrome, and register extraction.

documents.title: i.MX 8M Plus Applications Processor Reference Manual
documents.rationale: 7,429-page processor manual stressing memory, layout recursion, register tables, and throughput.

documents.title: S32K3xx Data Sheet
documents.rationale: Tagged automotive MCU datasheet with JavaScript, dense electrical tables, footnotes, and diagrams.

documents.title: PDF 1.7 / ISO 32000-1:2008 Specification
documents.rationale: 756-page PDF specification with syntax examples, nested tables, diagrams, and extensive cross-references.

documents.title: PGF/TikZ Manual
documents.rationale: 1,323-page graphics manual mixing TeX math, source code, vector illustrations, syntax blocks, and indexes.

documents.title: qpdf bad cross-reference fixture
documents.rationale: Minimal intentionally malformed PDF requiring cross-reference recovery.

documents.title: qpdf damaged inline-image fixture
documents.rationale: Intentionally damaged inline-image stream testing parser recovery without hangs or crashes.

documents.title: qpdf password-protected fixture
documents.rationale: Password-protected PDF control used to verify explicit, deterministic failure semantics.

documents.title: qpdf rotated-page fixture
documents.rationale: Twenty-page atomic fixture covering page rotation and inherited page geometry.

documents.title: RP2040 Data Sheet
documents.rationale: 642-page MCU datasheet with register fields, code snippets, timing diagrams, and tables.

documents.title: Renesas RA6M2 Group User’s Manual: Hardware
documents.rationale: 1,738-page hardware manual with register descriptions, block diagrams, bit fields, and dense tables.

documents.title: RISC-V Unprivileged ISA Specification
documents.rationale: 727-page ISA standard with instruction encodings, equations, pseudocode, and dense tables.

documents.title: The American Bible (public-domain scan)
documents.rationale: 382-page image-based historical book scan used as a no-OCR control and robustness case.

documents.title: Costume Design and Illustration (public-domain scan)
documents.rationale: 226-page illustrated image-based scan with plates, decorative typography, and no reliable text layer.

documents.title: AM62x Processors Technical Reference Manual
documents.rationale: 16,613-page, 135 MB reference manual: the corpus stress test for page trees, memory, and throughput.

documents.title: United Nations Annual Report 2023
documents.rationale: Visually designed report with photographs, oversized typography, data callouts, charts, and varied layouts.

documents.title: Why It Matters: Multilingualism at the United Nations
documents.rationale: Designed report mixing all six UN languages, timelines, callouts, images, and complex reading order.

documents.title: UN Security Council S/2024/748 (Arabic)
documents.rationale: 182-page Arabic RTL report with English/French inserts, numbered notes, tables, images, and annexes.

documents.title: The Unicode Standard, Version 16.0
documents.rationale: 1,140-page multilingual standard spanning complex scripts, character charts, tables, and technical prose.

documents.title: US Federal Budget FY2025 Table 26-1
documents.rationale: 475-page government budget table with wide numeric columns, tiny text, and repeated multi-page structure.

documents.title: USB MIDI 2.0 Specification
documents.rationale: Protocol specification with packet diagrams, bit-field tables, code values, and technical figures.

documents.title: veraPDF tagged-PDF failure fixture A
documents.rationale: Official atomic fixture with intentionally invalid tagged-PDF logical structure.

documents.title: veraPDF tagged-PDF failure fixture B
documents.rationale: Official atomic fixture with a second intentionally invalid tagged-PDF structure case.

documents.title: Vulkan SC 1.0 Specification with Extensions
documents.rationale: 2,105-page API standard with nested valid-usage lists, code, equations, extension tables, and cross-references.
